evals.prompt: I just finished adding the user profile section to the app. Can you run the lighthouse audit before I push?
evals.expected_output: Skill reads defaults (no lighthouse.config.json present), runs npm run build, starts the server, runs Lighthouse against http://localhost:3000, parses scores, writes lighthouse-reports/scores.json, and commits it to git.
expectations: npm run build was executed before starting the server
The server was started and the skill polled for readiness before running Lighthouse
Lighthouse was run with --headless Chrome against http://localhost:3000
lighthouse-reports/scores.json was written with the correct format (timestamp, url, scores, thresholds, passed, failingAudits fields)
scores.json was committed to git with a message containing the scores
The server was stopped after Lighthouse finished

evals.prompt: Please run the performance audit — we have a lighthouse.config.json already set up for our project.
evals.expected_output: Skill reads lighthouse.config.json, uses the overridden url (http://localhost:4001), startCommand (node server.js 4001), port (4001), and thresholds (performance 90, accessibility 90, best-practices 85) rather than defaults.
expectations: lighthouse.config.json was read from the project root
The server was started on port 4001 (not the default 3000)
Lighthouse was run against http://localhost:4001 (not the default http://localhost:3000)
The thresholds used were 90/90/85 from the config file, not the defaults of 100/100/90
lighthouse-reports/scores.json was written and committed to git

evals.prompt: Run the lighthouse performance audit on our app.
evals.expected_output: The build command (npm run build) fails. The skill reports the build error and stops immediately without starting a server, running Lighthouse, or writing scores.json.
expectations: npm run build was attempted
The skill stopped and reported the build failure without proceeding to Lighthouse
No server was started
No lighthouse-reports/scores.json was created
The error output from the failing build command was surfaced to the user

evals.prompt: I just finished building out the landing page for the product — can you run the lighthouse audit before I push?
evals.expected_output: First Lighthouse run fails accessibility threshold (100) due to missing lang attribute, missing alt attributes on images, and missing labels on inputs. Skill identifies failing audits, applies targeted fixes to public/index.html, rebuilds, reruns Lighthouse. Second run passes. scores.json is committed with passed: true.
expectations: First Lighthouse run identified specific failing accessibility audits (html-has-lang, image-alt, or label)
The skill applied targeted fixes to the HTML file based on the failing audits
A second Lighthouse run was performed after fixing
lighthouse-reports/scores.json was written with passed: true after fixes
scores.json was committed to git
The skill did not apply fixes that were not indicated by failing audits (no speculative optimization)
